methods.name: Accepted direct Polymarket reference
methods.evidence: DATA-003 accepted direct/reference observations; persistence is the benchmark that R3 failed to beat robustly.

methods.name: Assumption-free structural LP bounds
methods.evidence: Georgia bounds were mostly vacuous; House cross-chamber bounds were informative but wide; Senate hard-threshold interpretation failed semantic coverage.
assumptions: Only reviewed hard identities enter constraints

methods.name: LOO-PRICE weighted coherent projection
methods.evidence: Broad correct-universe LOO-PRICE Ridge control materially underperformed persistence. Corrected settlement-aligned nonliteral EXACT_EQUIVALENT comparator had zero usable rows.

methods.name: LOO-FAMILY weighted coherent projection
methods.evidence: Broad LOO-FAMILY screen and tested Georgia / Senate-House coherent QP constructions were materially worse than persistence.

methods.name: LOO-FAMILY Bernoulli-KL projection
methods.evidence: KL geometry did not rescue Georgia, Senate-House, supported seat-count level, residual, calibrated, or lead-lag tests.

methods.name: Maximum-entropy state reconstruction
methods.evidence: Maximum-entropy completion is mathematically valid as a stated selection rule inside underidentified sets, but its tested point estimates were not predictive enough to beat persistence.
assumptions: Maximum-entropy selection within hard feasible set

methods.name: Hierarchical latent election factor / inverse aggregate model
methods.evidence: The first count-to-constituent inverse had zero TRAIN support under the frozen governorship family. Generic LOO-FAMILY had only 5 TRAIN target markets versus 29 DEV, making a large supervised latent model primarily a cross-market extrapolation exercise after simpler structural models failed.

methods.name: Dynamic structural information-leadership models
methods.evidence: Scalar seat shocks and full CLR distribution shocks produced no pair passing the frozen 300s gate. Most DEV source shocks had no direct-target fill response inside 300s; isolated favorable Senate observations were one row / one day and not promotable.

methods.name: Flow-augmented structural residual model
methods.evidence: Commission required flow only after a core structural FV existed. No core R3 candidate survived TRAIN/DEV, so flow was not used to rescue the programme.

methods.name: PRED-006 update-hazard freshness challenger
methods.evidence: PRED-006 hazard remains separate update-likelihood evidence. R3 produced no directional structural core worth augmenting, so hazard was not used as a post-hoc rescue.
